extraction_notes: The job identity was preserved exactly: frozen campaign order 941, LCSC C51499, MPN AO4485, manufacturer Alpha Omega Semicon, family mosfet.
The canonical PDF identifies AO4485 as a 40V P-Channel MOSFET and shows Rev1: Nov. 2010. All four PDF pages were examined.
Signed p-channel voltage and current values are stored as magnitudes in numeric fields, while the published signs are retained in conditions strings.

Figures 1 through 8 were digitized conservatively from visible plotted traces. Curve temperature is stated only where the figure explicitly labels it; Figure 9 through Figure 11 were omitted because their log-scale limit and transient curves were not needed for reliable MOSFET DC extraction.
Electrical-characteristics values retain their published minimum, typical, or maximum provenance. RDS(on), capacitance, and gate-charge values retain the datasheet's published prefixed units.
